why: d2 is the September 2026 refresh of the deployment story: the Copilot IT checklist replaces the four-phase implementation framework with a five-phase path (plan, implement, adopt, manage, improve) and moves agent governance to day one; the Agent 365 observability playbook introduces Agent 365 as the control plane for every agent with new AI Administrator / AI Reader roles; and the June 2026 AI evaluation framework gives buyers the SATC rubric. d1 stands on its own: the success-kit decks, Customer Hub sessions, scenario library, adoption workbooks, the ESS readiness guide and the Microsoft Learn privacy, EDP, architecture and EU Data Boundary articles.
